_comment: Vortex waves configuration: auto_max_waves with a geometric_back rescue ladder and scale_cap=false decouple.
_note: Wave-queue configuration with geometric_back wave distribution and auto_max_waves resolution at boot.

vortex_dca._math: wallet_exposure caps total position notional (e.g. 15 = $15 on a $100 wallet).
vortex_dca._comment_grid_mode: === ORDERBOOK-ANCHORED GRID === Levels are placed at real bid/ask walls instead of fixed-pct spacings. Falls back to LINEAR if the book is too thin to bin nr_clusters walls in band.
vortex_dca._comment_scalper_entry_disabled: scalper_initial_entry intentionally OFF — initial grid uses the full nr_clusters wall-anchored levels, not a single scalper entry. This restores the old N-level fan-out at startup.
vortex_dca._comment_position: === PERSISTENT PLAN + EXTENSION (no adaptive — pure geometric continuation) ===
vortex_dca._plan_math: persistent_grid_plan stores the plan at entry and resets on TP/stoploss; dynamic_spacing keeps prices live. extend_grid_when_exhausted adds deeper levels (extension_max_levels at extension_distance) when the plan is exhausted, the position is open, and budget remains.
vortex_dca._comment_extension_orderbook: When grid_mode=orderbook, extension envelope = outer_distance (or live dynamic_spacing value), divided into max_levels sub-bands. Each level picks strongest wall in its sub-band → wall-anchored AND properly spread. Qtys are pure geometric continuation — no per-level budget multiplier, no min-notional-up-clamp. If a level falls below min_order_notional_usd it's dropped, not raised.
vortex_dca._comment_lock: Direction lock: refuse to move the long grid down as price drops, or the short grid up as price rises, so existing orders stay to fill.
vortex_dca._comment_entry_filter: === ENTRY FILTER (initial-only knife-catch) === When flat on a side, soft-block fresh grid placement if price is on the wrong side of a recent candle (long blocks if price <= recent low; short blocks if price >= recent high). Spike block skips both sides on wide-range candles. Applies ONLY to fresh-entry grid placement (calculate_initial_grid); rebalanced grid + extension grid for existing positions are unaffected. Combine with grid_mode=orderbook to anchor those initial levels at real walls.
vortex_dca._comment_staged: === STAGED INITIAL ENTRY === When a side is flat, place ONLY level 1 of the normal multi-level grid (smallest geometric qty, closest to mid). Optionally re-anchor level 1's PRICE at the strongest orderbook wall within a tight band of mid (scalper-style wall pick). Persistent plan still stores all N levels. After L1 fills → side has position → rebalanced grid places L2..N at their normal geometric qtys. Trade-off vs scalper_initial_entry: keeps normal grid sizing (no full-budget-in-one-shot). Trade-off vs plain multi-level: only one order on book at a time when flat.
vortex_dca._comment_wave_queue_canary: Wave-queue: max_waves and max_total_exposure_pct bound the number of waves and the hard cap relative to the soft cap.
vortex_dca._comment_gridspan_sizing: Quantities scale with live outer_distance / reference_outer_distance, clamped between min_scale and max_scale.
vortex_dca._comment_gridspan_scale_cap: scale_cap=false: quantities still scale with volatility while the cap stays at wallet_exposure × max_total_exposure_pct.
vortex_dca._comment_auto_max_waves: auto_max_waves resolves max_waves + wave_share at boot using share_distribution; operator-set max_waves/wave_share are overridden by the resolver — see the [VORTEX_AUTO_MAX_WAVES] log line for resolved values.
